36980.note: Institution-wide AP page plus programme table (Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry columns). Only AP subjects concluded with an exam are accepted; subject choice elective within requirements; an additional test cannot replace an AP exam. Explicit art-exclusion not stated, but accepted list excludes AP 2-D/3-D Art and Design and Drawing; no explicit 'not accepted' list. Requirements stated for Sept 2027 intake.
